14 Vectors & Matrices Foundational [1 mark]
In the graph below, the straight line is represented by y=2x+1y = 2x + 1y=2x+1. What are the coordinates of the y-intercept?
A. (0,2)(0, 2)(0,2)
B. (2,1)(2, 1)(2,1)
C. (1,0)(1, 0)(1,0)
D. (0,1)(0, 1)(0,1) ✓
Correct Answer: (D) — (0,1)(0, 1)(0,1)
The y-intercept occurs when the value of x is 0. Substitute x = 0 into the equation y=2x+1y = 2x + 1y=2x+1:

y=2(0)+1y = 2(0) + 1y=2(0)+1
y=0+1y = 0 + 1y=0+1
y=1y = 1y=1

Therefore, the coordinates of the y-intercept are (0, 1).
